title: Attention Is All You Need
takeaway: Self-attention alone, with positional encodings, replaces recurrence and parallelises training.

title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
takeaway: Showing worked intermediate steps in few-shot examples unlocks multi-step reasoning at scale.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
takeaway: Scale gives in-context learning: the model picks up tasks from examples in the prompt without gradient updates.
